title: One Ice Cube Changed Everything
description: Original 38-second visual animal comedy with escalating cause-and-effect, a false win, satisfying payoff, and seamless loop.
hook: A tiny otter snatches one ice cube from a wobbling tray in the first frame and slides away as the tray begins to tip.
retention_beats: 0-3s immediate ice-cube grab and tipping tray
3-7s floor chase with a skittering cube
17-23s hidden cube triggers a harmless chain reaction
29-35s cube lands perfectly in the water bowl
35-38s second cube flies to lens for loop
rewatch_trigger: A toy penguin in the background slowly rotates during the first half, later revealing it was nudged by the runaway cube.
loop_bridge: A second ice cube fills the final frame, matching the opening cube with the same sharp ice clink.

scenes.caption: GOT IT!
scenes.action: Otter grabs one ice cube from a wobbling tray and slides away.

scenes.caption: UH-OH
scenes.action: Otter slides after the skittering cube while a toy penguin subtly turns.

scenes.caption: WHERE'D IT GO?
scenes.camera: follow cube then snap to reaction
scenes.action: Cube slides beneath a cabinet and vanishes; otter freezes.

scenes.caption: EASY.
scenes.action: Otter proudly holds a tiny ice chip while the original cube keeps sliding behind the cabinet edge.

scenes.caption: WAIT…
scenes.action: The hidden cube taps the toy penguin, which bumps a spoon, which rolls a lemon.

scenes.caption: CATCH IT!
scenes.camera: rapid action-match cuts then brief slow motion
scenes.action: Otter dodges the lemon and turns as the original cube pops upward from the spoon.

scenes.caption: PERFECT.
scenes.action: Otter redirects the cube with one paw and it lands perfectly in the tiny water bowl.
Otter taps the tray with its tail; a second cube flies toward camera until it fills the frame.
